description: This Java source file defines the PlaceholderFactory class, which provides static factory methods to create instances of various Placeholder, PlaceholderResolver, and ExpressionResolver classes used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating placeholders for headers, entities, policies, topics, requests, and address placeholders, as well as methods for creating resolvers for placeholders and expressions.

classes.name: PlaceholderFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating Placeholder, PlaceholderResolver, and ExpressionResolver instances.

methods.name: newHeadersPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of HeadersPlaceholder (immutable singleton).

methods.name: newThingPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ThingPlaceholder (immutable singleton).

methods.description: Returns a new instance of EntityPlaceholder (immutable singleton).

methods.name: newRequestPlaceholder

methods.name: newPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Creates a new PlaceholderResolver for a given Placeholder and optional placeholder source.
